text:
Type: glass-door display cabinet with drawers
Use: displaying dishes, glassware and books, storing linens in drawers; dining room, living room
Style: traditional, farmhouse, Scandinavian
Materials: solid wood with a dark stained finish, clear glass door panes, inner shelves, metal knobs
Colors: dark black-brown, dark grey knobs
Shape: tall upright cabinet with two framed glass doors over three stacked drawers, small round knobs, flat cornice top, short square legs, solid and stately, heavy visual weight
Feel: warm, sturdy, classic, cozy
Goes with: white walls, warm wood floors, cream or rustic textiles; traditional, farmhouse or country dining rooms

product.name: HEMNES
product.description: Solid wood has a natural feel.
